crossRefs.note: So Abram went, as Yahweh had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.
Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son.…
On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.
I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Son of Abraham and Hagar; father of Arab tribes.

translations.web: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.
translations.bsb: Abraham and his son Ishmael were circumcised on the same day.
translations.kjv: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.
translations.asv: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.
